label: SYNTHETIC-DERIVED: one CelesTrak record's values under synthetic ids with replaced epochs; not served by any provider
description: SYNTHETIC-DERIVED: the base record's values under synthetic five-digit ids 99990-99997, each EPOCH replaced: 31 December, day 366, of five leap years (1960, 1996, 2000, 2024, 2056), two in the day-of-year form (D-384); and 2038-01-19T03:14:07 and 03:14:08, the last second a signed 32-bit time_t holds and the next, and 2050-06-15T12:00:00 (D-385); specification vectors, not catalogued objects, never observed at these epochs.
